name: TeamStarWolf - Phishing & Social Engineering
description: Curated practitioner view of Phishing & Social Engineering behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Human-targeted initial access and follow-on: gathering, luring, delivering, and executing via deception, plus account and MFA abuse enabling the intrusion. Cross-tactic selection of Enterprise ATT&CK techniques; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting), not incident frequency. Every technique ID and tactic is validated against the workbench's bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data.
